_comment: Critical journey for the dashboard fixture: a grower takes the nutrient pumps off automatic before changing the reservoir.
title: Take nutrient dosing off automatic

persona.group: Volunteer growers on the evening shift at a community hydroponics farm
knows: that the reservoir is about to be drained and refilled
that the pumps must not dose into an empty tank
does_not_know: where the monitor keeps pump controls
whether the change takes effect at once
persona.context: Standing in the growing bay with wet gloves, using the shared tablet on the wall

goal: Make sure the pumps will not add nutrients while the tank is empty
scenario: You are about to drain and refill the Bay 4 reservoir. Before you start, stop the system from adding nutrient solution on its own, and check that it has stopped.

start_state.data: readings as shipped with the page; dosing on automatic
